description: Get the account's token balance and plan. Plans are sold in leads and every price is in tokens: one new lead (a business found by a search, with enrichment, relevance check, verified address and the monthly re-check included) costs one token. Businesses the account already holds: enrichment is one token per five, enrolling in the monthly re-check one token per two. A named contact found on the open web costs 2 tokens, charged only when a person is found. Email verification is included at no charge. Unused tokens roll over, up to three months' allowance. Plans are bought and changed on the Lyre Leads website, not through these tools; the result carries the link.
name: get_balance
title: Token balance
